findings.requirement: Every Skill version is retained immutably and can be restored.
findings.observation: Version 0 is rebuilt from the currently deployed built-in Skill resource instead of being stored; V53 stores only versions greater than zero.
findings.consequence: A later built-in Skill update changes the displayed version 0 and changes what Restore version 0 applies, so the member's original text cannot be recovered.

findings.consequence: An Agent Factory member used in Wish Pool discussion neither receives nor persists Skill revisions, despite remaining within the FD's member-based acceptance.

findings.requirement: Shared experience records contain reusable lessons rather than prompt scaffolding.
findings.observation: The JSON example uses the literal placeholder 'Up to three brief reusable lessons, or NONE' for experience, while the instruction explicitly says only to replace skill_update. The parser accepts this placeholder as a valid non-NONE experience.
findings.consequence: A model that copies the example stores the instruction itself as shared experience.
findings.minimal_correction: Explicitly instruct the model to replace experience with actual general lessons or the exact string NONE.
